report.answer_text:
Jim proposes to Pam in the Season 5 premiere, "Weight Loss" (Season 5, Episodes 1/2).
Jim meets Pam for lunch at an interstate rest stop between Scranton and New York City. He proposes to her outside in the pouring rain, and she accepts ecstatically.[1] Pam was in New York at the time for a graphic design class.
He had tried earlier. In "Goodbye, Toby" (Season 4), Jim plans to propose[2], but Pam is disappointed that Jim did not propose to her.[2] The plan fell through.
The scene was also expensive to film. Jenna Fischer said it was the single most expensive scene in the show's run, lasting 52 seconds and costing $250,000.[3]
